title: 2025 Version for Network Online Auth
content:

title: Kpop competition
content:
Hello, I just submitted my project for the Kpop competition and for some reason it says I used a source file that I didn't use for this project. Is there anyway to have that removed?

![b31529b349c34cbdbb1dbd05c8756d03](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/462b61cd695a4f059047307c06297784/images/b31529b349c34cbdbb1dbd05c8756d03Screenshot%202025-04-06%20at%2016.59.40.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: This happens if any part of your design file can be linked to another. Even if it’s as small as the fabric texture, stitch, trims? It doesn’t matter if you have deleted and not used actual garment.I wouldn’t worry as long as your design is clearly different.The designer who created that super realistic pink / leather jacket / skirt render used someone else’s leather jacket as a starting block so I really wouldn’t worry.
content_description: This web page provides support for resolving source file attribution errors in Kpop competition project submissions.

title: COMPUTER
content:
Hi The Fashion Shed 

Can you advise me what spec to get on a computer, my laptop is to recommendation for CLO but clearly it's not powerful enough. I want to get a tower computer. Also do you give private training. 

Thanks Vikki

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi @vikkijessop you can also find the CLO recommended specs on our websitehttps://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/0b6e5dfbff704c6199ffaa73ccb265ea

Comment 2: As long as it’s not slowing you down it’s all fine. I had a iMac before my PC and it was so slow!!! When your rendering catwalks and need to render 400 frames the difference between a 30 second render vs 2 mins makes a massive difference.
content_description: Provide expert computer specifications and private training recommendations tailored for CLO users.

title: How to Enjoy the AR Filter: Get Cuter or Funnier 😂✨
content:
Hey creators,

Are you interested in AR filters? Or do you think they've already peaked?  
If that's the case, then pay attention now! 

Create moments that are cuter and more fun than you ever imagined with AR outfits. This AR filter can be worn by anyone, from babies to adults, so experiment with your own style! 🤭💥

Try out styles you can play around with, from trendy clothes to popular meme outfits. Put on the latest fashion or surprise your friends with a laugh-inducing meme outfit! 😎👗

# **👶 Cute Version?**

We tried this AR filter on babies, and it was too cute! The little ones look absolutely adorable in their hip-hop outfits!

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N1uv8y8oQgo?start=0

  


# **🤣 Funny Version?**

But when we applied the filter to an aerobics-dressed guy? A totally different vibe! It turned into a fun vibe that had everyone laughing! 😂 You wouldn’t believe how much one filter can change the vibe!

![2944b2fbb2f44e2788ea8243d137cbdc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/03a603ec73524b37b5176dd069041e16/images/2944b2fbb2f44e2788ea8243d137cbdcapply.png)

  


# **💡 How to Use the AR Filter**

1️⃣ Scan the QR code above. (You can use Snapchat or TikTok apps.)  
2️⃣ When the camera opens, select the filter.  
3️⃣ Try on a virtual outfit on your smartphone screen!  
4️⃣ Take a photo or video and share it on our community page or social media!

# **💡 Tips for Use!**

✔️ Upload your photos or videos to Social Media and share them with your friends!  
✔️ Try different poses to find your unique style!  
✔️ Experiment with cute or funny versions to create different looks!

# **🎨 Want to Create Your Own?**

Would you like to create your own filter? We already have a Snapchat AR filter tutorial ready for you, [so check it out!](https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/9431689555343-Tutorials)

And the best part? We're also working on a **TikTok** tutorial, so stay tuned!🎥🔥 

If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment! 😊

  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/03a603ec73524b37b5176dd069041e16/images/7ab643faa62d4c03b05bef017f38e8f9thumb.png)
content_description: Discover and experiment with fun, cute, and trendy AR outfit filters for all ages, and learn how to create and share your own unique augmented reality styles!
